name: Shree Manufacturing Company Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1976, Shree Manufacturing Company Limited used to manufacture textiles.
keyPoints:
Operational Status:[1]
Company was engaged in manufacturing of textiles. But at present, company has no factory left. Company is trying to revive itself by doing some trading business and eventually planning to set up a factory some time in future and restart manufacturing.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
